  # ...

- Root-level arrays (each element checked for `_ulid`)
- Nested fields: `modules`, `features`, `requirements`, `constraints`, `decisions`, `traits`, `acceptance_criteria`

- Falls back to single object format
- Uses `TaskSchema.safeParse()` to validate each task

- Falls back to `spec/` subdirectory
- Falls back to parent directories
- Stops at first valid manifest found

- Recursively searches subdirectories
- Common locations: `project.tasks.yaml`, `kynetic.tasks.yaml`, `backlog.tasks.yaml`, `active.tasks.yaml`

- Expanded relative to manifest directory using glob patterns
- Supports `*` (single level) and `**` (recursive) wildcards
